name: Digital India
benefit: Free digital literacy training, DigiLocker, UMANG app, BPO jobs in small towns, CSC services
benefit_hindi: Muft digital saksharta training, DigiLocker, UMANG app, chote shaharon mein BPO naukri

eligibility.description: All Indian citizens eligible for digital literacy and services
eligibility.description_hindi: Sabhi Bharatiya naagrik digital saksharta aur sevaaon ke liye yogya hain
criteria: For PMGDISHA: One person per household who is not digitally literate

steps: Visit nearest CSC (Common Service Centre) for digital literacy training
Download DigiLocker app or visit digilocker.gov.in for document storage
Download UMANG app for government services
Contact PMGDISHA center for free computer training
steps_hindi: Nearest CSC center jaayein digital training ke liye
DigiLocker app download karein documents ke liye
UMANG app download karein sarkari sevaaon ke liye
PMGDISHA center par muft computer training lein

hindi_summary: Digital India mein muft computer training, DigiLocker mein documents safely rakhein, aur UMANG app se sarkari kaam karein. Nearest CSC center par jaake training le sakte hain.
